community_guidelines.be_kind_guideline: Couchers.org is an inclusive community where people of all cultures and backgrounds come together. Treat everyone with mutual respect and dignity.
community_guidelines.no_dating_title: This is not a dating app
community_guidelines.no_dating_guideline: Couchers.org is NOT for dating or hooking up. Harassment or using the platform for the purpose of dating or hooking up will result in a ban.
community_guidelines.be_safe_guideline: Read profiles, references, and resources. Report any inappropriate content or behavior.
community_guidelines.no_money_guideline: Keep things non-transactional. Don't exchange money while staying or hosting. Couchers.org is about learning, experiences, and getting to know people.
